data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking the Nifty Smallcap 250 Total Return Index
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to provide total returns that, before expenses, closely correspond to the total returns of the securities as represented by Nifty Smallcap 250 Index, subject to tracking error. However, there is no guarantee or assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Constituents of Nifty Smallcap 250 Index and Units of Liquid Schemes and Money Market Instruments
